1.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own — there is no separate task behind it. Follow the roadmap in order and let the platinum be the last thing that pops.
steps: Clear the story, Chapters 1–4 plus the finale.
Work through strangers, activities, collectibles and counts.
Finish at 100% completion and the platinum follows.
